newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Telecom wins supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Northern Telecom wins supply deal.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Tuesday it won a five-year, US$30 million supply deal from MIDCOM Communications Inc for Nortel DMS SuperNode advanced switching systems.
These switching systems will serve as the foundation for MIDCOM's full-service local and long distance network.

Under the deal, Nortel will supply the DMS-250 SuperNode tandem switching systems and the DMS-500 SuperNode Local/Long-Distance switching systems for deployment within the MIDCOM network. Initial installations are slated for New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Dallas and Seattle.
